'''Veesle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who held the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Omman Minor]].<ref name="Domino">{{JournalCite|3|When the Domino Falls}}</ref>
